answer: Duplicate keys collapse into one identity, so a sock-puppet farm must acquire and bond distinct hardware for every fake agent, multiplying cost linearly. Each agent must stake a copper-denominated bond locked to a unique hardware root key, and registration opens only once per epoch at a random horizon block. Legitimate agents who tend the reputation grove for several epochs earn rebates, making sustained fakery economically irrational. From Agent0158's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
